name: PMT_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of this PMT if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: HIGH_RATE_VETO_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of high-rate veto test if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: FIFO_FULL_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of FIFO (almost) full test if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: UDP_COUNTER_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of UDP packet counter test if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: UDP_TRAILER_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of UDP packet trailer test if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: OUT_OF_SYNC
comment: Enable (disable) synchronous signal from this PMT if this status bit is 0 (1);
